name: stl4
summary: STL node/tree conformance demo (clang-built C++ — clang-simplified's wasm/demos/stl_features4.cpp: node-based map/set iterator stability + std::function target recovery)

stl4-demo.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Menu launcher: stl4 is a tty app (the STL conformance report on stdout), so
# run it in a terminal window and hold the window open for the verdict — the
# etl-tests pattern. Self-location is a known-prefix probe (todos/0444):
# /opt/<name> installed, /usr/opt/<name> baked; `[` is a hush builtin —
# zero spawns (the old dirname-of-realpath command substitution cost four).
# Variable-free by design (#296): builtins and literal paths only.
[ -d /opt/stl4 ] && exec term sh -c "/opt/stl4/stl4; echo; echo '[stl4 demo done — press Enter to close]'; read _"
exec term sh -c "/usr/opt/stl4/stl4; echo; echo '[stl4 demo done — press Enter to close]'; read _"
